items.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 25, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: as Bernstein said play more devotedly and perform even harder than we ever have before

ctx.x: Oh gosh. Yeah. You know it’s up to, the hardest part about being an artist or a musician I think is the creation, the continuous creation of art and we have to look at this time as that’s another part of the gift, to get ourselves physically together, that’s why I try to walk as much as I can every day. We’ve been doing about two miles a day. Not a lot and I should do more. You know and try to eat right. But then getting down into making yourself better as an artist — all that stuff that you want to give to…
